sloka: क्रीडन्ती राज हंसेन पद्म षंडेषु नित्यशः ।हंसी सा तृण षण्डस्थम् कथम् द्रक्षेत मद्गुकम् ॥३-५६-२०॥
transliteration: krīḍantī rāja haṁsena padma ṣaṁḍeṣu nityaśaḥ ।haṁsī sā tṛṇa ṣaṇḍastham katham drakṣeta madgukam ॥3-56-20॥

translations.english: How can a female swan ever sporting in lotusponds in the company of a royal swan look at the watercrow resting on a grassy land?
